principle: Enclosure quality of a certified first-cell object L_1 <= inf over cell 0 of R''', from committed K1 magnitudes and certified operator constants only. No category depends on the sign or size of any R''' value.
reference_scale: S* = max_r sup|Hhat_r| on CUSUM cell 0 (committed candidate suprema, D_at_e0/H_at_e0 minus eps_mid). A heuristic scale anchor for the order-2 candidate size, NOT an estimate of R'''.
metric: m = 1, G-residual factor 1 (binding); radius of the certified first-cell interval

classes.STRUCTURALLY_BLOCKED: the strategy has no finite certified bound (a required object has no certified source)

strategy_A: graded whole-cell radius on cell 0 (certified C_e0, C_o0)
strategy_B: point radius at e = 0 under assumption A1 (point-run residual magnitudes equal the committed e0 magnitudes) + (x_1^2/2) M5 with the anchored certified tower; the conservative proxy point radius is reported, not binding
preferred_strategy: the better class; ties by smaller radius

next_step_rule.PREPARE_GOVERNED_REAL_CELL_QUALIFICATION: verdict QUALIFIED_FOR_GOVERNED_REAL_CELL_QUALIFICATION and preferred class PROMISING or MARGINAL with certified constants
next_step_rule.REPAIR_GRADED_OPERATOR_CERTIFICATE: preferred class UNINFORMATIVE with certified constants but PROMISING or MARGINAL for the same strategy with the non-certified operator estimate C_o0 = 4.68 (the certificate slack is the binding lever)
next_step_rule.BUILD_CHEAP_R5_MAJORANT: strategy B would be preferred but no certified M5 source exists
next_step_rule.SEEK_ALTERNATE_K5_ROUTE: UNINFORMATIVE for both strategies even with the non-certified operator estimate, or a soundness failure
